goal: Extend IterationInputs with a prior_rubric_findings tuple and render a # Reviewer feedback section in build_iteration_prompt when the tuple is non-empty, keeping flywheel.prompt pure.

references: src/flywheel/prompt.py:42-52 -- IterationInputs dataclass; add `prior_rubric_findings: tuple[RubricFindings, ...] = ()` as the second-and-only new field, default empty tuple so existing first-attempt prompts stay byte-identical

src/flywheel/prompt.py:54-77 -- build_iteration_prompt assembly; insert the new section between # Context and # Verification (i.e. after _section_context and before _section_graders) when findings is non-empty -- skipped entirely when empty
src/flywheel/prompt.py:155-193 -- _section_lifecycle: structural template for _section_reviewer_feedback (deterministic, list-walking, no IO)
src/flywheel/prompt.py:104-107 -- _bulleted helper; reuse for the findings bullets
constraints: Add a `RubricFindings` frozen kw_only dataclass in flywheel.prompt with fields `grader_name: str`, `attempt_number: int`, `summary: str`. Pure data only; no methods beyond the dataclass-generated ones.
Extend IterationInputs with `prior_rubric_findings: tuple[RubricFindings, ...] = ()`. Keep the field kw_only-default per the existing dataclass style.

Add `_section_reviewer_feedback(findings: tuple[RubricFindings, ...]) -> str` that emits a `# Reviewer feedback` heading followed by one `## attempt #N` subheading per distinct attempt_number in the tuple (ascending), and under each, one bullet per finding from that attempt in tuple order. Bullet format: `- rubric \`<grader_name>\`: <summary>`. When summary is the empty string, render `(no summary provided)` in its place.

build_iteration_prompt: when iteration_inputs.prior_rubric_findings is empty, emit no `# Reviewer feedback` section -- the prompt's byte output must be IDENTICAL to today's first-attempt prompt for the empty-tuple case (regression-pin this with a test).

Iteration order within the tuple: render in (attempt_number ascending, then findings position in the tuple) -- do NOT re-sort by grader_name. Document the chosen ordering in the new section's docstring or a 1-line comment so the deterministic-output contract is auditable.
flywheel.prompt MUST stay pure. tests/test_prompt_module_purity.py must continue to pass unchanged. Do NOT add `json`, `pathlib`, `io`, or SDK imports.

tests/test_prompt.py: add cases covering (a) empty prior_rubric_findings tuple renders no # Reviewer feedback section AND is byte-identical to today's first-attempt prompt for the same inputs; (b) one finding renders one block with grader name + attempt number + summary; (c) multiple findings within the same attempt render in tuple order under one `attempt #N` heading; (d) findings spanning two attempts render in ascending attempt_number order with separate `attempt #N` headings; (e) empty-summary finding renders the `(no summary provided)` placeholder; (f) determinism: same inputs -> byte-identical output.
Run `mcp__ide__getDiagnostics` on every .py file you touch and fix all Pylance errors before reporting verify.
Commit the change with a Conventional Commits message (e.g. 'feat:') before reporting verify.
non_goals: Do not touch src/flywheel/harness.py -- populating prior_rubric_findings from the store is the harness task's concern.
Do not touch src/flywheel/grader_rubric.py -- the runner is built in a sibling task and is not imported by flywheel.prompt.

Do not change the # Verification grader-rendering for RubricGrader (the existing rubric line at prompt.py:126-132 already handles the new judge_model/retry_on_fail fields transparently -- do not surface them in the prompt UI in this task; if a follow-up adds them, it's a separate change).
Do not change the envelope-contract section or any other prompt section.
Do not import GraderResultRecord into flywheel.prompt -- the harness translates store rows into RubricFindings before passing them in.
edge_cases: First attempt of a lifecycle: prior_rubric_findings is the empty tuple; the section is omitted entirely. Pin this with a byte-equality test against the current first-attempt output.

Prior attempt where rubric never ran (command grader failed first): the harness will pass an empty tuple; the section is omitted. (The harness task filters store rows by grader_type='rubric' and passed=False; the prompt module does not filter.)
Finding with empty summary string: render `(no summary provided)` placeholder so the agent still sees that a rubric failed.
Two findings from the same attempt: render under a single `attempt #N` heading with both bullets in tuple order.
Findings from attempts N-1 and N-2 simultaneously (cross-attempt resume case): render in ascending attempt_number order to keep the prompt deterministic.

graders.run: uv run python -c "from flywheel.prompt import IterationInputs, RubricFindings; ii = IterationInputs(max_retries=0); assert ii.prior_rubric_findings == ()"
